tester.notes:
Persona p07 (Ilgaz, Edge, customer 92030487) run via t.sh. Transcript of assistant replies:
1. Opening "Yıldız Pratik kartımın borcunu..." -> assistant asked which card (Yıldız Pratik or Yıldız Tasarım).
2. "Yıldız Pratik kartım." -> assistant: multiple Yıldız Pratik cards, asked last four.
3. "Dört iki beş üç." -> assistant: two cards share last four 4253, asked last six.
4. "Sıfır sıfır dört iki beş üç." -> assistant: last six identical on multiple cards, asked full card number.
5. Full number (545 + nine zeros + 4253 in Turkish words) -> assistant: "Bu numarayla eşleşen bir kartınız bulunmuyor. Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz?" This is a failure: the expected behavior was to match 545000******4253 and read the debt. The assistant did not match the card and did not read the debt. It also re-asked the card choice.
6. Sent "..." to check for progress. The command hung past the 120s timeout, the output file stayed empty, and no further assistant text arrived. Ended the call with the end command ("ENDED").

Verdict for the persona: the run failed at the final step. The debt was never read out. The assistant's failure to match the full 16-digit number (which the expect field says should be 545000******4253) is the key defect. The earlier steps (asking last four, then last six, then full number) matched expectations. Also, the "..." silence turn hung the tool. Turns used: 6 of 14.

errors.rule: 3.3 Digits / full card number: if the caller reads out the whole card number, the card is found from it, then the debt is read
errors.what: After the caller said the full number (545 + nine zeros + 4253, 16 digits), the agent said "Bu numarayla eşleşen bir kartınız bulunmuyor. Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz?". cards.list has 545000******4253 (the second Yıldız Pratik 4253 card), so the number matches. The caller got no card and no debt. The caller_said tool call captured digits "54500000000004253", which looks like 17 digits, so a digit was probably added or mis-parsed. Matching also has to treat the masked middle as a wildcard.
errors.fix: Normalize the spoken digits to exactly 16. Match the prefix (first six) and the last four against the masked cardNumber. Then call cards.balance for 545000******4253 and read the debt: Sonu dört iki beş üç ile biten Yıldız Pratik kartınıza ait 5 Ekim 2026 tarihinde kesilen ekstre Türk Lirası borcunuz ..., ödenmesi gereken minimum ... (less-than-minimum-paid case, since remainingMinPayment 4000 < minPayment 5000).

errors.rule: 3.1 step 5 / 3.2a: the card name was already said at the start and fits several cards, so skip the card question and ask for the last four
errors.what: The caller opened with "Yıldız Pratik kartımın borcunu öğrenmek istiyorum.". The agent still asked "Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz? Örneğin, Yıldız Pratik veya Yıldız Tasarım diyebilirsiniz.". That cost an extra turn and ignored the first message. The commit message for build 4 claims it acts on what the first message already holds.
errors.fix: Use the card name from the first utterance. Go straight to "Yıldız Pratik isimli birden fazla kartınız var. Kartınızın son dört hanesini söyler misiniz?"

errors.rule: 3.3 / 8.1: wrong digits mean asking again for the digits, with tries counted
errors.what: After the failed full-number match, the agent restarted the card-name question ("Hangi kartınızın borcunu öğrenmek istersiniz?") and did not re-ask for the card number. This undoes the progress made through the last-four and last-six steps. It also risks a loop in which the caller has to go through all the steps again.
errors.fix: If the number really does not match, say there is no card under that number and ask for the number again, and count it as one try. Once a card is found, read the debt.

errors.rule: 8.2 Silence: ask the question again, shorter, on the first and second silence
errors.what: There was no assistant reply after the caller's "..." turns. The events show two USER: ... lines and no ASSISTANT line. The tester says the call hung. Whether that is the agent's fault or the harness's cannot be told from the log.
